paragraphs.text: translated by
1. In the great synod will I laud thy two Bay Steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-God,
paragraphs.original: प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी प्र ते वन्वे वनुषो हर्यतं मदम् ।
paragraphs.translit: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī pra te vanve vanuṣo haryataṃ madam |

paragraphs.text: His who pours lovely oil as 'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.
paragraphs.original: घृतं न यो हरिभिश्चारु सेचत आ त्वा विशन्तु हरिवर्पसं गिरः
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secata ā tvā viśantu harivarpasaṃ giraḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Ye who in concert sing unto the gold hued place, like Bay Steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat,
paragraphs.original: हरिं हि योनिमभि ये समस्वरन्हिन्वन्तो हरी दिव्यं यथा सदः ।
paragraphs.translit: hariṃ hi yonimabhi ye samasvaranhinvanto harī divyaṃ yathā sadaḥ |

paragraphs.text: For Indra laud ye strength allied with Tawny Steeds, laud him whom cows content as 'twere with yellow drops.
paragraphs.original: आ यं पृणन्ति हरिभिर्न धेनव इन्द्राय शूषं हरिवन्तमर्चत
paragraphs.translit: ā yaṃ pṛṇanti haribhirna dhenava indrāya śūṣaṃ harivantamarcata

paragraphs.text: 3. His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms;
paragraphs.original: सो अस्य वज्रो हरितो य आयसो हरिर्निकामो हरिरा गभस्त्योः ।
paragraphs.translit: so asya vajro harito ya āyaso harirnikāmo harirā gabhastyoḥ |

paragraphs.text: Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage. In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue.
paragraphs.original: द्युम्नी सुशिप्रो हरिमन्युसायक इन्द्रे नि रूपा हरिता मिमिक्षिरे
paragraphs.translit: dyumnī suśipro harimanyusāyaka indre ni rūpā haritā mimikṣire

paragraphs.text: 4. As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunderbolt spread out as in a race.
paragraphs.original: दिवि न केतुरधि धायि हर्यतो विव्यचद्वज्रो हरितो न रंह्या ।
paragraphs.translit: divi na keturadhi dhāyi haryato vivyacadvajro harito na raṃhyā |

paragraphs.text: That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.
paragraphs.original: तुददहिं हरिशिप्रो य आयसः सहस्रशोका अभवद्धरिम्भरः
paragraphs.translit: tudadahiṃ hariśipro ya āyasaḥ sahasraśokā abhavaddharimbharaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old. hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired.
paragraphs.original: त्वंत्वमहर्यथा उपस्तुतः पूर्वेभिरिन्द्र हरिकेश यज्वभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃtvamaharyathā upastutaḥ pūrvebhirindra harikeśa yajvabhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect pleasant gift, O Golden-hued from birth.
paragraphs.original: त्वं हर्यसि तव विश्वमुक्थ्यमसामि राधो हरिजात हर्यतम्
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ haryasi tava viśvamukthyamasāmi rādho harijāta haryatam

paragraphs.text: 6. These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, Thunder-armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill.
paragraphs.original: ता वज्रिणं मन्दिनं स्तोम्यं मद इन्द्रं रथे वहतो हर्यता हरी ।
paragraphs.translit: tā vajriṇaṃ mandinaṃ stomyaṃ mada indraṃ rathe vahato haryatā harī |

paragraphs.text: Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have the gold-hued Soma juices run.
paragraphs.original: पुरूण्यस्मै सवनानि हर्यत इन्द्राय सोमा हरयो दधन्विरे
paragraphs.translit: purūṇyasmai savanāni haryata indrāya somā harayo dadhanvire

paragraphs.text: 7. The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong.
paragraphs.original: अरं कामाय हरयो दधन्विरे स्थिराय हिन्वन्हरयो हरी तुरा ।
paragraphs.translit: araṃ kāmāya harayo dadhanvire sthirāya hinvanharayo harī turā |

paragraphs.text: He who speeds on with Bay Steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.
paragraphs.original: अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्जोषमीयते सो अस्य कामं हरिवन्तमानशे
paragraphs.translit: arvadbhiryo haribhirjoṣamīyate so asya kāmaṃ harivantamānaśe

paragraphs.text: 8. At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the Iron One with yellow beard and yellow hair.
paragraphs.original: हरिश्मशारुर्हरिकेश आयसस्तुरस्पेये यो हरिपा अवर्धत ।
paragraphs.translit: hariśmaśārurharikeśa āyasasturaspeye yo haripā avardhata |

paragraphs.text: He, Lord of Tawny Coursers, Lord of fleet-foot Mares, will bear his Bay Steeds safely over all distress.
paragraphs.original: अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्वाजिनीवसुरति विश्वा दुरिता पारिषद्धरी
paragraphs.translit: arvadbhiryo haribhirvājinīvasurati viśvā duritā pāriṣaddharī

paragraphs.text: 9. His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles move apart, what time, for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir,
paragraphs.original: स्रुवेव यस्य हरिणी विपेततुः शिप्रे वाजाय हरिणी दविध्वतः ।
paragraphs.translit: sruveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śipre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: When, while the bowl stands there, he grooms his Tawny Steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he loves.
paragraphs.original: प्र यत्कृते चमसे मर्मृजद्धरी पीत्वा मदस्य हर्यतस्यान्धसः
paragraphs.translit: pra yatkṛte camase marmṛjaddharī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Yea, to the Dear One's seat in homes of heaven and earth the Bay Steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food.
paragraphs.original: उत स्म सद्म हर्यतस्य पस्त्योरत्यो न वाजं हरिवाँ अचिक्रदत् ।
paragraphs.translit: uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyoratyo na vājaṃ harivām̐ acikradat |

paragraphs.text: Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the Beloved One hath gained high power of life,
paragraphs.original: मही चिद्धि धिषणाहर्यदोजसा बृहद्वयो दधिषे हर्यतश्चिदा
paragraphs.translit: mahī ciddhi dhiṣaṇāharyadojasā bṛhadvayo dadhiṣe haryataścidā

paragraphs.text: 11. Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new.
paragraphs.original: आ रोदसी हर्यमाणो महित्वा नव्यंनव्यं हर्यसि मन्म नु प्रियम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā rodasī haryamāṇo mahitvā navyaṃnavyaṃ haryasi manma nu priyam |

paragraphs.text: O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.
paragraphs.original: प्र पस्त्यमसुर हर्यतं गोराविष्कृधि हरये सूर्याय
paragraphs.translit: pra pastyamasura haryataṃ gorāviṣkṛdhi haraye sūryāya

paragraphs.text: 12. O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee, delightful, golden-visored, on thy car,
paragraphs.original: आ त्वा हर्यन्तं प्रयुजो जनानां रथे वहन्तु हरिशिप्रमिन्द्र ।
paragraphs.translit: ā tvā haryantaṃ prayujo janānāṃ rathe vahantu hariśipramindra |

paragraphs.text: That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest, at the feast, drink of our offered meath.
paragraphs.original: पिबा यथा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वो हर्यन्यज्ञं सधमादे दशोणिम्
paragraphs.translit: pibā yathā pratibhṛtasya madhvo haryanyajñaṃ sadhamāde daśoṇim

paragraphs.text: 13. Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest; and thine especially is this libation.
paragraphs.original: अपाः पूर्वेषां हरिवः सुतानामथो इदं सवनं केवलं ते ।
paragraphs.translit: apāḥ pūrveṣāṃ harivaḥ sutānāmatho idaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te |

paragraphs.text: Gladden thee, Indra, with the meath-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One! within thee.
paragraphs.original: ममद्धि सोमं मधुमन्तमिन्द्र सत्रा वृषञ्जठर आ वृषस्व
paragraphs.translit: mamaddhi somaṃ madhumantamindra satrā vṛṣañjaṭhara ā vṛṣasva
